title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - ThresholdJob
description: The Threshold Job is the operational entity to execute a threshold (a set of threshold rules). As part of the definition of a Threshold Job, a scope of monitored objects is provided and a schedule for the threshold evaluation is determined. (TM Forum TMF649 Performance Thresholding 5.0.0, OpenAPI component ThresholdJob; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:ThresholdJob:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ThresholdJob'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'ThresholdJob' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ThresholdJob/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:ThresholdJob:<tmfId>. Unique identifier of the Threshold Job, used to reference and manage it within the Threshold Management system.

adminState.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ThresholdJob/properties/adminState'. Enumeration of administrative states of a resource. Possible values indicate whether the resource is locked, unlocked, or shutting down.

creationDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ThresholdJob/properties/creationDate'. Timestamp indicating when the Threshold Job was originally created in the Performance Management system.

executionState.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ThresholdJob/properties/executionState'. The current runtime state of the Threshold Job. Supported states: 'Active' - The job is currently active and executing threshold evaluation. 'Suspended' - The job is temporarily stopped but can be resumed. 'Failed' - The job stopped due to a failure. 'Completed' - The job has finished its execution successfully and is no longer active.

granularity.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ThresholdJob/properties/granularity'. Defines the evaluation granularity of the Threshold Job (e.g., G_5MN, G_15MN, G_30MN, G_1H). It specifies the periodic time interval at which KPIs are assessed against threshold rules.

jobPriority.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ThresholdJob/properties/jobPriority'. Relative priority level assigned to the Threshold Job. Higher priority jobs may be executed or scheduled ahead of lower priority jobs.

lastUpdate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ThresholdJob/properties/lastUpdate'. Timestamp of the most recent update or modification to the Threshold Job definition.

monitoredObjectsCriteria.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ThresholdJob/properties/monitoredObjectsCriteria'. Criteria that define the scope of monitored objects (resources, services, or customers) to which the Threshold Job applies.

performanceThreshold.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ThresholdJob/properties/performanceThreshold'. In TMF this is a ThresholdRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced Threshold entity (urn:ngsi-ld:Threshold:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

scheduleDefinition.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ThresholdJob/properties/scheduleDefinition'. The schedule definition for running jobs.

trackingRecord.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF649_PerformanceThresholding/blob/v5.0.0/TMF649-Performance_Thresholding-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ThresholdJob/properties/trackingRecord'. Optional field to store tracking or correlation information related to the Threshold Job (e.g., audit trails, external references, or operator notes).

allOf.description: Specifies recurrence on particular days of the month (1–31).

days.description: List of days in the month on which recurrence occurs.
List of days in the week on which recurrence occurs.

Extensible.description: Base Extensible schema for use in TMForum Open-APIs - When used for in a schema it means that the Entity described by the schema MUST be extended with the @type

@type.description: When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

@baseType.description: When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

@schemaLocation.description: A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

HourRange.description: Represents a range of hours within a single day. The range can have only a start time, only an end time, or both. Times must be specified in 24-hour HH:mm format.

startHour.description: The beginning of the hour range, expressed in 24-hour HH:mm format (e.g., 09:00 for 9 AM, 17:30 for 5:30 PM).

endHour.description: The end of the hour range, expressed in 24-hour HH:mm format (e.g., 12:00 for noon, 23:59 for one minute before midnight).

MonitoredObjectsCriteria.description: Monitored objects are specified by the MonitoredObjectsCriteria.

monitoredObjectFilter.description: A filter that can be used in conjunction with the monitored object class for specifying the set of instances that are referenced

allOf.description: The schedule definition for running jobs.

id.description: Identifier of the schedule definition, it should be locally unique

recurringFrequency.description: A recurring frequency to run a job within day that is included in schedule definition, for example: every 5 minutes, 15 minute, 30 minutes, 1 hour

excludedDate.description: A list of specific dates that should be excluded from the Schedule Definition.

scheduleDefinitionHourRange.description: A list of time ranges within a specific day that the schedule will be active on, for example 08:00-12:00, 16:00-19:00.

weeklyScheduleDefinition.description: The weekly schedule is used to define a schedule that is based on the days of the week, e.g. a schedule that will be active only on Monday and Tuesday.

monthlyScheduleDayOfMonthDefinition.description: The schedule definition for running the threshold job

dateScheduleDefinition.description: The date schedule is used to define a schedule that is based on specific dates and times. Each value must be a valid IETF RFC 3339 date-time string (e.g., '2015-12-31T23:59:59Z', '2013-02-28T09:00:00-05:00').

TimePeriod.description: A period of time, either as a deadline (endDateTime only) a startDateTime only, or both

startDateTime.description: Start of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format

endDateTime.description: End of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format
